summary.en: Hezbollah explosives were seized in a truck at a checkpoint and Lebanon’s prime minister pledged a thorough investigation, while Lebanese security forces also seized another explosives-laden vehicle. In northern Israel, a teenager was killed and dozens injured when a Hezbollah submunition exploded in his backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, prompting authorities to consider limiting hikes in the area. Israeli forces continue artillery and air strikes in southern Lebanon, targeting Hezbollah positions and causing civilian casualties. The conflict has produced 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Hezbollah-eksplosiver ble beslaglagt i en lastebil ved en kontrollpost, og Libanons statsminister lovet en grundig etterforskning, mens libanesiske sikkerhetsstyrker også beslagla et annet eksplosivbelastet kjøretøy. I Nord-Israel ble en tenåring drept og dusinvis såret da en Hezbollah-submunisjon eksploderte i ryggsekken hans under en fottur nær Libanons grense, noe som fikk myndighetene til å vurdere å begrense turer i området. Israelske styrker fortsetter artilleri‑ og luftangrep i Sør-Libanon, rettet mot Hezbollah-posisjoner og forårsaker sivile tap. Konflikten har ført til 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
